$comment: Shape returned by kaggle_log_monitor action='status' / action='get'. The widget transforms this; it never fetches it.

intervalSeconds.description: The interval currently in effect. This is what a monitoring subagent reads at the start of every cycle.

revision.description: Increments only when the applied interval actually changed. Equal revisions across two reads means no edit landed in between.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last accepted change, or null when the file has never been written.

targets.description: What is being watched. Empty means no monitor is registered, which the widget must state plainly.

ref.description: Kaggle kernel ref owner/slug. Present when kind='kaggle'.

path.description: Local log file path. Present when kind='local'. Display basename only; do not send an absolute path into prompt metadata.

exists.description: Whether the config file has been created. false means defaults are in effect and no edit has been persisted.

displayRules.pendingVersusApplied: When the slider differs from intervalSeconds, the slider value is labelled pending and the applied value is shown separately. They are never merged into one number.
displayRules.clampReporting: If the tool reports clamped=true, the applied value is displayed, never the requested one.
displayRules.rounding: All seconds are whole numbers. No fractional display.
displayRules.emptyTargets: targets.length === 0 is an explicit state, not an error: say nothing is watched yet.
